name: boAt Airdopes 141 Bluetooth Earbuds
description: boAt Airdopes 141 is a pair of wireless Bluetooth earbuds designed for everyday music listening, calling, and entertainment. It offers wireless connectivity, a portable charging case, touch controls, and a comfortable fit. It is targeted at students, young professionals, and budget-conscious users who want convenient wireless audio.

features.name: Ergonomic Fit
features.explanation: Comfortable lightweight form factor for fatigue-free listening.
